source.title: Purging Earth
source.description: A familiar bottle of sapta lay wrapped in the smudged notes. It's strangely murky, yet the magic mostly feels familiar. There is a faint sensation of foreign magic, tainting the mix. Your instincts tell you there must be a Spirit Rock nearby, though you cannot recall any. Locating it may help you get to the bottom of this mystery.
source.objective:
Find the tainted Spirit Rock and drink the Murky Earth Sapta.

Provided item:
source.completion:
Life grow again. Strength needed.

Corruption elsewhere. Find and stop.
